The text you provided is in Coptic, specifically the Sahidic dialect. Here is the translation into English:

**"May the good God grant us justice and righteousness. May He give us knowledge and understanding, and may He guide us in the way of truth and righteousness."**

### Breakdown of the Translation:
1. **Ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲥⲉⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲣⲉⲙϩⲉⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉⲧϣⲱϣ ⲉ̀ ⲁⲝⲓⲁ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲇⲓⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥⲩⲛⲏ.**
   - *"May the good God grant us justice and righteousness."*
   - Ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲓ (Ephouai) = "May He give" (a form of ⲫⲟⲩⲁⲓ, "to give").
   - ⲥⲉⲙⲓⲥⲓ (semisi) = "good" (feminine form).
   - ⲣⲉⲙϩⲉⲩ (remheu) = "us" (indirect object pronoun).
   - ⲉⲧϣⲱϣ (etshōsh) = "justice."
   - ⲁⲝⲓⲁ (axia) = "righteousness."
   - ⲇⲓⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥⲩⲛⲏ (dikaiosynē) = "righteousness" (Greek loanword).

2. **Ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲟⲩ ⲥⲉⲉⲣϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲅⲛⲱⲙⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲥⲩⲛⲏⲇⲏⲥⲓⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛϭⲣⲉⲩⲁⲣϣⲏⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲉⲧⲣⲱⲙⲓ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲥ̀ⲛⲏⲟⲩ.**
   - *"May He give us knowledge and understanding, and may He guide us in the way of truth and righteousness."*
   - ⲥⲉⲉⲣϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ (se-erhmot) = "may He give" (subjunctive form).
   - ⲅⲛⲱⲙⲏ (gnōmē) = "knowledge."
   - ⲥⲩⲛⲏⲇⲏⲥⲓⲥ (synēthēsis) = "understanding."
   - ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛϭⲣⲉⲩⲁⲣϣⲏⲧ (m-penjreuarshēt) = "may He guide us."
   - ⲙ̀ⲙⲉⲧⲣⲱⲙⲓ (m-metrōmi) = "in the way."
   - ϩⲓⲛⲁ (hina) = "of."
   - ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲥ̀ⲛⲏⲟⲩ (n-thōou m-phrēti n-snēou) = "truth and righteousness."

This is a prayerful or liturgical text, likely from a Coptic Christian context, invoking divine guidance and wisdom.
